notes.subject: society
notes.why_in_news: The UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs released the World Urbanisation Prospects 2025 report, revealing Jakarta has overtaken Tokyo as the world's most populous city due to new methodology.
notes.fact_box: The UN report estimates Jakarta's population at 42 million, followed by Dhaka at 37 million and Tokyo at 33 million. The report notes that urban dwellers now comprise nearly half of the world's 8.2 billion people, up from 20% in 1950.
